description: Test suite for the iscc_sdk module, testing metadata extraction and embedding functions using pytest.

classes.name: IsccMeta
classes.description: Data class representing metadata for media files, including optional identifier.

methods.name: test_extract_metadata
methods.description: Tests extracting metadata from a JPEG file and verifies the returned dictionary matches expected values.

methods.name: test_extract_metadata_unsupported
methods.description: Tests that extracting metadata from an unsupported SVG file raises the IsccUnsupportedMediatype exception.

methods.name: test_embed_metadata
methods.description: Tests embedding metadata into a JPEG file and verifies the embedded metadata can be extracted correctly.

methods.name: test_metadata_identifier_field_image
methods.description: Tests embedding metadata with an identifier into a JPEG file and verifies correct embedding.

methods.name: test_embed_metadata_unsupported
methods.description: Tests that embedding metadata into an unsupported document file returns None.
